test_title: PYST 30: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 11 Aug, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.**

The __person who dislikes and distrusts other people__ lived alone in a secluded cabin deep in the woods, far away from the hustle and bustle of society.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Misanthrope**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Misanthrope **means a person who dislikes and distrusts other people. (एक व्यक्ति जो अन्य लोगों को नापसंद करता है और उन पर अविश्वास करता है)
 
• It is the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the sentence.
 
• The word is derived from the Greek words "misos" (hatred) and "anthropos" (human).
 
 
• **Example**: "*He was a misanthrope who avoided social gatherings and preferred to be alone.*"
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Pessimist **refers to a person who always expects the worst and has a negative outlook on life. (निराशावादी से तात्पर्य उस व्यक्ति से है जो हमेशा सबसे बुरे की उम्मीद करता है और जीवन के प्रति नकारात्मक दृष्टिकोण रखता है)
 
• **Hermit **refers to a person who lives in seclusion. (हर्मिट का तात्पर्य ऐसे व्यक्ति से है जो एकांत में रहता है)
 
• **Recluse **also refers to a person who lives in seclusion. (वैरागी का तात्पर्य ऐसे व्यक्ति से भी है जो एकांत में रहता है)
